run_video_caption_evaluation: run LAVILA 0-shot video caption evaluation on Ego4D dataset using a checkpoint file
run_beam_search_captioning: run beam search caption generation with configurable num beams and length penalty
run_group_beam_search_captioning: run group beam search caption generation with multiple beam groups for diverse outputs
decode_generated_token_ids: decode generated token IDs into text strings using the tokenizer and EOS token
evaluate_caption_with_nlgeval: evaluate generated captions against ground truth using NLGEval metrics like BLEU and METEOR
